firstRedraw.Mirror:
Use case: style-transfer. REDRAW the event illustration from scratch in the EXACT drawing language of the supplied project style references. Portrait 3:4 opaque full scene, crisp high resolution.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 installed Warrior = PRIMARY authority for thick black contours, simple color planes and graphic forms; Image 2 installed B1 environment = PRIMARY authority for broad architecture and deep SOLID INK BLACK negative shapes; Image 3 user original fighter = primary drawing/shape simplification reference; Image 4 installed Wizard = authority for simplified expressive elderly faces, chunky hands and grouped beard/hair, not NPC costume; Image 5 previous EVENT painting = rejected rendering, CONTENT ONLY. Do not preserve its realistic rendering.
REQUIRED RESULT: a strongly DRAWN game illustration belonging beside images 1–4. Large flat ink-black shapes must carve into the subjects and surroundings, not merely border the perimeter. Bold selective contour strokes and only 2–3 broad planes on each form. Quiet untextured color fills, few angular edges, chunky stylized shapes. Narrow muted olive/umber/slate/bone palette with one small warm accent. Strong object-specific visual emphasis; surroundings should fall into connected ink black and a few simple planes.
NO semi-realistic anatomy/modeling, no sculpted cheek planes, no beard hairs, no finely modeled folds, no grain, stippling, canvas texture, tiny cracks, little facets, glow wash or painted atmospheric realism. Do not simply darken image 5 or apply a vignette/filter. Do not copy the reference characters into the scene. No typography/border/signature/watermark.
CONTENT / focal composition: a large old standing mirror in an intact castle dressing room. Maintain the story of an anonymous hooded reflection raising a sword independently, with no person outside the glass. The MIRROR is the unmistakable main object: simple thick dark wooden frame surrounding one broad pale desaturated blue-gray glass plane. Inside it the figure is a single bold BLACK CLOAK SILHOUETTE with just 2–3 sharply cut slate planes, chunky gloved grip and ONE simple pale sword crossing it. The pale glass and blade against the reflection's black silhouette form the strongest contrast in the entire image, immediately readable at 500 px tall. Make this graphic contrast, not a glowing magic portal. The empty wardrobe room should largely disappear into solid black; one quiet wall plane and a subdued hanging cloth suggest place. Keep a small low candle only as a secondary tiny amber accent, far less dominant than the mirror. Use large clean intact surfaces, NO tiny stone edges or textured wood. Sword grip/guard/blade must be mechanically connected. Same full-height subject and 3:4 popup asset format; you may simplify/recompose the surroundings to give the mirror clear focal priority.

cleanup:

Keep image 1's exact portrait 3:4 composition, pilgrim pose, facial expression, hands and their natural grip, stone sizes, memorial engraving, sack, candle, architecture, palette, lighting and strong solid BLACK shadow masses.
Make ONLY this cleanup: remove the mottled gritty material grain from the entire cloth sack, clothing and stone surfaces, replacing it with clean restrained large color planes like the project references. Merge the little triangular hair/beard highlights into 2–3 large clean grouped shapes, without changing face design or silhouette.
